literature_notes: The computed topology assigns the C-terminus (342–354) to the intracellular compartment, directly conflicting with the experimental finding in L2 that C-terminal GFP is extracellularly accessible. PMC7660923 is a topology-determination paper; their non-permeabilized immunostaining result is the primary experimental evidence and is treated as overriding the computational prediction for this site. The N-terminus (residues 1–75) is intracellular per both the computed topology and the experimental result in L3 (N-terminal GFP not detected under non-permeabilized conditions), so no N-terminal surface site is proposed. L4 and L5 describe N-terminal HA attempts but the N-terminus is intracellular; these are captured in other_positions. L6 (N-terminal FLAG and C-terminal His in HEK293) does not report a surface-localization result and therefore does not independently ground a site. No internal extracellular loop insertions are supported by any ledger line.

literature_rejected.reason: topology: C-terminus is intracellular, not extracellular

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal GFP (GFP-mPR) showed no staining under non-permeabilized conditions, confirming the N-terminus is intracellular; consistent with computed topology placing residues 1–75 in the cytoplasm.

N-terminal HA (HA-mPR) was tested as a smaller alternative to GFP at the N-terminus after GFP impaired trafficking; the N-terminus is intracellular per topology and L3, so this tag is not on the extracellular surface.
